unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 敌人，仇人；危害物，大敌
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Cats and mice have always been natural enemies.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 敌人，仇人；危害物，大敌。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 能源；能量；精力；活力
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm always full of energy after jogging.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：en-(在里面) + erg(工作) + -y(名词后缀) -> 在体内支撑工作的源泉 -> 能量/精力

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 工程师；设计师
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to be an IT engineer when I grow up.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: engine（发动机）+ eer（人）= 玩转机器的工程师

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 英语；英语学科 `adj.` 英语的；英格兰的；英格兰人的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Ms Li teaches English.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 英国(Eng)人说英语。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 喜爱；欣赏；享受……的乐趣
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Enjoy them all!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：en(使)+joy(欢乐) -> 带来欢乐，享受(enjoy)其中。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 足够地；充分地 `pron.` 足够；充分 `det.` 足够的；充分的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Second, I don't drink enough water.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“一拿福”，联想：过年时长辈一拿出大“福”字，就说明家里有足够的福气了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 输入；录入(姓名、数字等)；(2) 进入；进去；进来；(3) 报名参加
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please knock on the door before you enter the teacher's office.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. (1) 输入；录入(姓名、数字等)；(2) 进入；进去；进来；(3) 报名参加。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 环境；客观环境
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should plant more trees to protect our natural environment.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 环境；客观环境。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 特别；尤其
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Everything tasted good, especially the steamed chicken soup.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀法: especially 是在 specially (特别地) 前加 es 强化语气，意为“尤其”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` (1) 即使；甚至；连；(2) 更加；甚至 `adj.` 偶数的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She even speaks some Chinese!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拆分谐音：e(鹅) + ven(拼音：吻)。这只鹅“甚至”敢去主动亲吻(ven)大黑狗！

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 傍晚；晚上
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's nine o'clock in the evening.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 早晨morning，晚上evening。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (体育运动的)比赛项目；重要事情，大事
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Did you hear that there's an e-sports event this weekend?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：e (出) + vent (来) -> 出来的事情，即大事、活动或比赛项目。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 曾经；以往任何时候；从不
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Emma: Hardly ever.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆法：把never(从不)的n拿掉，就变成了在任何时候(ever)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det.` (1) 每个；每一个；(2) 每(表示频率，与数词、other或few连用)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every week, under the tree.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想/图像记忆法 (e想鹅，v想剪刀，ery想容易：每只鹅剪毛都很容易)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 每个人；所有人；人人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Everybody in our class is looking forward to the school trip.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：pron. 每个人；所有人；人人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 每天的；日常的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: That's an important part of my everyday life.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 每天的，everyday。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `pron.` 所有事物；每件事，一切
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can't carry everything.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：every (每个) + thing (东西) = 所有东西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 各个地方；到处；处处
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You'll see robots working everywhere.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: every(每个) + where(地方) = 到处。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` (1) 精确地；确切地；准确地；(2) (用于强调正确)完全正确
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Exactly! How about Ella?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: exact (精确的) + ly，完全正确。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (`=examination`) (1) 测试；(笔头、口头或操作)考试；(2) 体检；检查
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I know it's near your exams.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 缩写记忆：Examination 的缩写，ex- (出/结果) + -am (我是)，考试测出‘我是谁’。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 范例；实例；(2) 楷模；榜样
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: For example, we celebrate William Shakespeare's birthday...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ex (出) + ample (充足的) -> 举出充足的例子来证明。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 极好的；优秀的；杰出的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My music teacher is excellent.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: excel (优秀) + lent，特别优秀的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `prep.` 除……之外；除了；只是
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The passage mentions the following EXCEPT the students' French level.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: ex- (向外) + cept (拿) -> 拿出去不要就是除了 (except)，不要和接受 (accept) 混淆。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 激动的；兴奋的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm excited, and also sad.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ex(出) + cit(喊) + ed，激动得喊出来excited

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 令人激动的；使人兴奋的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: PE, because it's exciting.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: excite (使兴奋) + ing，形容事物令人兴奋。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 借口；理由；辩解 `v.` 原谅；宽恕；为……辩解；同意免除
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Excuse me, is this your ...?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：ex-(向外) + cuse(理由) -> 给出理由去开脱 -> 原谅

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) (身心的)锻炼；(2) 习题；练习；(3) (保持健康的)一套动作
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do eye exercises every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 饿死(exer)赛跑(cise)要锻炼(exercise)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 盼望；期待；(2) 预期；预料
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I expect to be back within a week.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ex（向外）+ spect（看） -> 往外看，期盼，即“预期、预料”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 价格高的；昂贵的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Watches are so expensive.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 花钱(pen)买昂贵(expensive)的东西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 经历；经验 `v.` 体验；经历
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I don't think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：ex- (出) + peri (尝试) + -ence (名词后缀) -> 尝试出来的就是经验。
